subject: Post-call exec recap: VertexSystems discovery + executive alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vertexsystems.com>, Samantha Price <samantha.price@vertexsystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call exec recap: VertexSystems discovery + executive alignment

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the candid discussion and the opportunity to align with your leadership team. High level recap and agreed next steps below: 

Key business outcomes you care about:
- Reduce support automation costs by ~40% through better retrieval + hallucination control across customer service flows.
- Improve agent productivity (first-contact resolution) by surfacing concise action items from case histories.
- Maintain tight latency SLAs (<200ms tail) for customer-facing features.

Top pain points discussed:
- Current API vendor has inconsistent latency at peak and no predictable reserved capacity for launches.
- Cost volatility per token drives hesitation on rolling to production for real-time use cases.
- Enterprise procurement needs SOC 2 + data residency guarantees for EU customers — you flagged this as a blocker for Q2 rollout.

Technical notes we captured:
- Primary workload: real-time chat + summarization from transcripts (avg seq len ~800 tokens; spikes to 2k).
- Expected steady-state traffic: 250 rps, burst to 1k rps during campaigns.
- Integration: want to use existing event pipeline (Kafka) + signed webhooks for streaming responses.

Commercial / procurement path:
- Jordan: exec sponsor identified (David Park, CPO) — will drive budget approval and procurement timeline.
- Suggested go-t0-market: start with a 6-week PoC scoped to one product line, then commit to Dedicated capacity.
- Legal: you requested a draft SOW and baseline pricing for a Dedicated pool + staging capacity.

Open risks / escalation items:
- SOC 2 evidence & data residency confirmation for EU traffic (security will need to verify).
- SLA exception for <200ms tail at peak — may require reserved Dedicated nodes or burst policy.
- Procurement timeline: you indicated procurement cycles end of Q2; any delays here push target launch to Q3.

Agreed next steps (owner / ETA):
- Redwood to share: executive one-pager + draft SOW + initial pricing (Marissa) — by EOD Mon 2/29. [Attachments: redwood-exec-summary-vertexsystems.pdf, SOW-draft-vertex-v1.docx]
- Vertex to share: security questionnaire contact & initial SOC2 request (Jordan) — by Tue 3/2.
- Schedule follow-up with David Park to review business outcomes and procurement path (Marissa + Jordan) — target week of 3/8.

If I missed anything or you want this framed differently for David, tell me and I'll update before the exec call.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0162
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-exec-summary-vertexsystems.pdf (PDF, 3 pages) — executive one-pager
SOW-draft-vertex-v1.docx (DOCX, draft) — scope and timeline

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vertexsystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Price <samantha.price@vertexsystems.com>, David Park <dpark@vertexsystems.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: VertexSystems discovery + executive alignment

Thanks Marissa — great summary and aligns with our notes. A few quick items from our side:

- Confirm David (CPO) is aligned on the business outcomes; he asked for a 1-page focused on ROI for our service org (would be helpful to call out cost reduction and FTE equivalence).
- Security: I'll route the SOC2 request to our security team; expect a contact by EOD Monday.
- Procurement: tricky timeline but David will push for Q2 if the SOW and pricing are clean.

Let's lock a 30-minute time for the exec sync next week — David is available Tue 3/9 morning PT or Thu 3/11 afternoon PT.

—Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Product, Vertex Systems
jordan.lee@vertexsystems.com | +1 206-555-0188

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: VertexSystems discovery + executive alignment

Quick internal note — flagged items for the solutions and legal teams: 

- SOC2 / data residency: Ops should prepare a short evidence packet (attestation + EU-only region option). I'll loop in Security (Tom H.) and Solutions (Aditya) to scope the minimal artifacts.
- Pricing: we should propose both Dedicated baseline and an initial PoC discount to reduce friction; recommend: 3-month PoC pricing at 40% off Dedicated list with capped burst credits.
- SLA: to hit <200ms tail at peak we'll likely require a dedicated pool with pre-warmed KV cache and burst policy — note this as a required line item in the SOW.
- SOW: start with a 6-week PoC scope, deliverables: integration support, performance tuning, and monthly ROI check-ins.

I'll prepare the SOW skeleton and send to Marissa for review by EOD Mon. Aditya — can you confirm capacity/technical feasibility for the burst numbers (1k rps) and the expected cost estimate?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vertexsystems.com>, David Park <dpark@vertexsystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: VertexSystems discovery + executive alignment

Thanks Jordan — looping David so he has the exec one-pager in advance. David, attaching a short ROI bullet sheet that calls out the expected 40% support cost reduction and the deployment timeline options (PoC -> Dedicated).

Next steps I'll take now:
- Finalize and send the 1-page ROI + draft SOW by EOD Mon 2/29.
- Coordinate a proposed exec sync for Tue 3/9 morning PT; I'll send a calendar invite once Jordan confirms final availability.
- Laura / Aditya to prepare SOC2 evidence packet and capacity notes ASAP — will include in a shared Drive link.

If procurement wants an initial PO to start PoC onboarding, we can accept a short-term PO and roll into the Dedicated contract after an evaluation (happy to outline that option in the SOW).

Best,

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
